title: LicoUp model provider configuration
description: One model endpoint: identity, dialect, credential handle, catalog and versioned compatibility options. No endpoint and no model id is pre-listed, no key material appears here, and no price is asserted as spent. A dialect that is not a published compatible one owes its own stream adapter rather than imitating a compatible API.

baseUrl.description: The endpoint. A credential handle issued for one origin is not resolved for another, so pointing this at a new origin does not inherit the old secret.

apiDialect.description: The dialect the endpoint speaks, in the provider's own words. `openai-chat-compatible` and `openai-responses-compatible` need no adapter code.

credentialRef.description: A host-issued handle. Key material pasted here is refused before the configuration is stored, logged or graphed.

catalogSource.description: `static` lists the models here and needs no `modelProvider.models` call; `discovered` requires the provider to implement it.

id.description: The vendor's own model id. It is not namespaced: the catalog key already carries the provider id and generation.

tools.description: Null means the vendor published nothing. A reader may not substitute false.

reasoning.description: Null means unknown; no reasoning strength is invented to fill a uniform table.

contextTokens.description: Null means unknown; no default window is substituted.

pricingSource.description: A reference to a price estimate. It is never an incurred cost: cost is an observation.

compat.description: Versioned semantic parameters, never key material.

streamAdapter.description: Required when the dialect is not a compatible one: a custom API supplies its own stream adapter.
